name: Money Train 2

features.name: Money Cart bonus
features.description: Three respins where only bonus symbols land; respins reset with each new symbol.

features.name: Persistent symbols
features.description: Collector, Payer, Sniper and Necromancer symbols interact to boost values.

review: Money Train 2 remains the benchmark for "money cart" style bonuses. The persistent special symbols – Collectors, Payers, Snipers and the Necromancer – combine in so many ways that no two bonuses look the same. It's very volatile, but the bonus is entertaining even when it pays poorly, which is rare.
cons: Bonus can be expensive to reach
